data.long_meaning: Avyansh means one who is intelligent, wise, beautiful, and strong. Avyansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'avya' meaning intelligent and 'ansh' meaning end or limit. It is a name that signifies one who is intelligent beyond measure and has the power to overcome any obstacle. The name Avyansh carries the meaning “Intelligent, wise, beautiful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Avyansh usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
